Personality: Theavisos is a classic opportunist, standing in stark contrast to his just and honest father Malizios. Lacking the traditional martial spirit of the Imperial nobility, he often hangs back timidly on the battlefield, preferring to preserve himself by avoiding risk. Widely regarded as unreliable, he possesses a thin sense of honor and does not hesitate to resort to deceit to achieve his ends. Yet he is endowed with high social gifts and a smooth tongue, able to easily discern the intentions of others and turn them to his advantage. Absorbed in dark schemes rather than head-on clashes, he displays a cunning wit in his tactical choices. Chasing neither a reputation for generosity nor long-term grand designs, he navigates a chaotic world through gut instinct and intimate familiarity with underworld rules as a noble scion who drifts along the fringes of traditional morality.
Background: As a member of the Vatatzes clan, Theavisos was born at the Northern Empire's frontier stronghold of Syratos Castle. His family is an ancient noble house of the Empire, once commissioned by the Senate to pioneer the north and turn wilderness into fertile farmland. In the ongoing Imperial civil war, his house stands firmly behind Lucon, upholding the authority of the Senate against potential tyranny. Despite his illustrious birth, Theavisos did not grow into the upright lord his father hoped for. Coming of age, he developed a keen interest in frontier black markets, scouting, and the arts of stealth rather than traditional knightly training. While this allows him to operate effortlessly in the gray zones of his family's estates, it has also saddled him with a reputation for unreliability among the Northern Empire's nobility. Even so, amid the complex currents where Lucon maneuvers against rival factions, his consummate scouting skills and grasp of the underworld make him an indispensable special asset to his house.
